{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Constitution assigns the federal government no role in local education.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Federal authority over the nation's schools has increased dramatically.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Annual federal funding for education has increased by 41 percent to almost $25 billion in less than a decade.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The regulatory burden on state and local governments has risen by about 6.7 million hours during the same time.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The increased regulatory burden on state and local governments has added $141 million in costs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for a review of Department of Education programs and administration to identify and eliminate ineffective programs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for respecting the role of states in education.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for better meeting state needs in education.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for block-granting more Department of Education funding to the states.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for requirements for state-level standards, assessments, and public reporting to ensure transparency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Local educators must be free to end ineffective programs and reallocate resources where they are most needed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to fulfill the promise of the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act to cover 40 percent of the costs incurred because of that legislation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Urging preventive efforts in early childhood, especially assistance in gaining pre-reading skills, to help many youngsters move beyond the need for IDEA's protections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
